decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1. The proposed development, by way of it's size, siting and location,  would be harmful to the appearance and openness of the Green Belt, contrary to policies ENV 1.1, ENV 4.3, ENV 4.4 and ENV 5.9 of the Unitary Development Plan and policies ENV.N 1.1, ENV.N 1.2 and ENV.N.2.10 of the Review Deposit Unitary Development Plan, and no demonstration has been made of very special circumstances to overcome this harm, contrary to PPG 2 'Green Belts'
2. The resultant increase in activity on the site over a 24 hour period from this intensification of use of the site would be harmful to the Green belt objectives for the area, contrary to Policies ENV 1.1, ENV 4.3, ENV 4.4 and ENV 5.9 of the Unitary Development Plan, policies ENV.N 1.1, ENV.N 1.2 and ENV.N 2.10 of the Review Deposit Unitary Development Plan and PPG 2 'Green Belts'
3. The Local Planning Authority and the Highways Agency consider that the development of a drive thru food facility on the exit slip road to the westbound M4 could cause congestion at the motorway  service station and impact on traffic flows to the adjoining M4 motorway, contrary to Policy T.2.5 of the Unitary Development Plan and policy T.1.4 of the Review Deposit Unitary Development Plan and PPG 13 'Transport'.  
4. The Local Planning Authority and the Highways Agency consider that the provision of a drive thru food facility on the exit slip road to the westbound M4 would encourage drivers to eat and drink whilst driving, which would be prejudicial to highways safety, contrary to policy T.2.3 of the Unitary Development Plan and policy T.1.4 of the Review Deposit Unitary Development Plan and PPG 13
description: Erection of building to provide a drive thru takeaway.
